messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Congratulations! Aap Telenor ke customer loyalty draw mein jeet gaye hain — 100,000 rupay!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Nahi madam yeh official hai. Sirf 1,500 ka SIM verification fee hai, balance aap ke account mein aayega.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Fee maaf kar do phir manon gi.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Fee ke baghair process nahi hota. Aaj raat 12 baje tak bhejo warna next winner ko chala jaye ga.
